title: Meridian Roasters
tagline: Small-batch coffee, roasted at the edge of dawn.

sections.heading: Our Story
sections.body:
Meridian Roasters started with a single drum roaster in a converted garage and a stubborn belief that coffee should taste like where it came from.

Today we source green beans directly from farms across Ethiopia, Colombia, and Sumatra, roasting in small batches every week so every bag reaches you at its peak.

sections.heading: What We Offer
sections.body: From single-origin pour-overs to espresso blends built for milk drinks, we roast for how you actually drink your coffee.
items: Wholesale accounts for cafes and offices

sections.heading: Why Meridian
sections.body: We roast to order, not to a warehouse shelf. Every batch is cupped and logged before it ships, and we publish the roast date on every bag.

footer: Meridian Roasters — roasted at the edge of dawn.
